svg.text: Horizon National Bank · retrieval-augmented policy assistance with deterministic validation
Home · Dashboard · Upload · Analysis · Policy AI · Sentiment · Voice · Search · Monitoring
MASKING BOUNDARY — account number, PAN, Aadhaar, customer ID and name are masked before this line. The model never receives an unmasked identifier.
DefaultAzureCredential → bearer token → every service. User-assigned managed identity id-bankai-app holds five data-plane roles.
Secrets in Key Vault (RBAC mode, purge protection). No keys in code, no connection strings.
1536 dimensions · same deployment as the corpus
temperature 0 · strict JSON schema · refuses when uncovered
status ← rule engine, never the model. reason ← model explanation, which affects nothing.
Agreement raises confidence to HIGH. Disagreement lowers it to LOW and flags the case for manual review.
human_review_required = True — assigned in Python after generation. No code path sets it False.
One AIServices resource (S0, custom subdomain) fronts all five. Single endpoint, single managed-identity grant.
Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, no public access
Policies only. Customer records are never indexed.
Four independent layers. An attack must defeat all four.
Azure AI Content Safety / Prompt Shields — returns HTTP 400 before the model sees the prompt
System prompt rules 1–8 — grounding, refusal string, retrieved text is data not commands
Strict JSON schema — the decision enum contains no APPROVED or REJECTED value
Post-generation guards — prompt-leak suppression, human_review_required override
Layer 4 exists because layer 2 proved unreliable: the assistant disclosed its system prompt on one run and refused on another, under identical settings.
The prompt states intent. Code enforces it.
OpenTelemetry spans → Application Insights → Log Analytics. Latency p50/p95, token spend, document success rate, grounding rate.
Spans emitted through the OTel API surface in the dependencies table, not customEvents. Automatic instrumentation captures every outbound Azure call.
Expanding 7 → 12 policies reduced vector and improved keyword.
Hybrid absorbed both and held flat.
6 prompt injection, incl. indirect via corpus
Region centralus · Azure for Students · eastus blocked by regional policy
A4 · Horizon National Bank AI Assistant · Architecture v1.0
